rationale: The second 5-min candle since entry printed a clear bullish bar closing at $6.50 on nearly 3× the volume of the first candle, signaling that buying pressure is accelerating into the resistance zone rather than failing there as the short thesis required. Maximum favorable excursion remains zero — the trade has never been onside — and price is now within $0.04 of the $6.54 invalidation, making the remaining downside risk (~$0.04 to stop) disproportionate relative to the stalled reward; exiting now at approximately $6.51 limits the loss to ~$0.06/share versus risking a full stop-out at $0.09/share against a thesis that has shown no confirmation.
